extension.summary: LibTV - Your Kodi Library as Real TV
extension.description: Turn your movies and TV shows into linear channels with full TV guide support. Generates an M3U playlist and XMLTV guide for PVR IPTV Simple Client, with plugin-resolved streams so channels play whatever is currently on air.
extension.news: v0.14.0: short episodes could still get wrong guide bars, and still drop back to the guide when they ended - live testing found different causes behind the same symptoms. Smart-playlist channels are evaluated through a Kodi call that reports an item's runtime but not its stream details, so episodes whose scraper set no runtime had no duration at all; LibTV now asks Kodi directly for a duration it's missing. Durations measured during playback are no longer discarded whenever the add-on is upgraded, are stored under a name the guide builder can actually look up, and no longer wait up to six hours to be used - learning that a file contradicts the guide now rebuilds it within half a minute. A programme watched from start to finish now measures its own duration, rather than trusting what the player reports about a live stream. An item with no duration anywhere takes a slot length based on the rest of its channel instead of a flat 90 minutes. When a programme ends early, playback continues with the next one instead of giving up, and re-selecting a channel late in an over-long slot starts the next programme rather than the last few seconds of the previous one. Each rebuild and each tune now logs where its durations came from.
